description: NaSn₄(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.94 Å. There are two inequivalent Sn sites. In the first Sn site, Sn is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.15 Å) and two longer (2.16 Å) Sn-O bond lengths. In the second Sn site, Sn is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Sn-O bond lengths are 2.13 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sn and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one P atom.
